And these kind of experiments aren't limited to unit 731. Imperial Japanese Army surgeon Ken Yuasa later said that vivisection was common practice amongst military doctors in China. At least 1,000 Japanese medical personnel performed such operations in occupied territories. We did this more for practice than for research. It was routine. We needed to train.
